name: Pectoralis major
actions: flexes the arm at the shoulder (clavicular fibres)
dailyLifeRole: Pushes a door open, pushes yourself up from the floor and hugs someone.

review.notes: OpenStax lists adduction and raising the arm forward; medial rotation and clavicular flexion are standard anatomy not stated on the OpenStax page. Confirm. Wikidata Q532798 (identity check).

name: Pectoralis minor
dailyLifeRole: Holds the shoulder blade forward and down when you reach or breathe in deeply.

review.notes: Sits under pectoralis major, so it is not drawn on the body map; nearest slug chest used. Wikidata Q757083 (identity check).

name: Serratus anterior
actions: holds the scapula against the rib cage
dailyLifeRole: Lets you reach forward and keeps the shoulder blade flat when you push or lift overhead.

review.notes: Wraps the side of the rib cage, no matching body-map slug; nearest slug chest used. Upward rotation of the scapula is standard anatomy but not on the OpenStax page. Confirm. Wikidata Q743294 (identity check).

name: Latissimus dorsi
dailyLifeRole: Pulls your arm down and back, as in climbing, rowing or pulling a heavy door shut.

review.notes: Body map has no lats slug; upper-back is the nearest drawn area. OpenStax words the action as moving the elbow backward and drawing the elbows apart; extension, adduction and medial rotation are standard anatomy. Confirm. Wikidata Q283673 (identity check).

name: Biceps brachii
dailyLifeRole: Bends your elbow to lift a bag and turns your palm up to take a cup.

name: Brachialis
dailyLifeRole: Does the main work of bending the elbow whichever way your palm faces.

review.notes: Lies deep to biceps brachii; body map slug biceps is the nearest. Placed in the biceps group because the catalogue has no brachialis group. Wikidata Q752441 (identity check).

name: Brachioradialis
actions: flexes the elbow, most when the thumb points up
dailyLifeRole: Helps bend the elbow when you carry or hammer with the thumb up.

review.notes: OpenStax states elbow flexion only; thumb-up emphasis is standard anatomy. Confirm.

name: Triceps brachii
actions: long head extends the arm at the shoulder
dailyLifeRole: Straightens your elbow to push yourself out of a chair or press something overhead.

review.notes: Shoulder-extension role of the long head is standard anatomy not stated on the OpenStax page. Confirm. Wikidata Q83379 (identity check).

name: Forearm flexors
dailyLifeRole: Give you grip strength to hold a bag handle, bar or phone.

review.notes: Group record covering flexor carpi radialis, flexor carpi ulnaris and flexor digitorum superficialis (all in OpenStax). Pronator and deeper finger flexors not included.

name: Forearm extensors
dailyLifeRole: Hold the wrist straight so your grip stays strong while you lift or type.

review.notes: Group record covering extensor carpi radialis (longus and brevis), extensor carpi ulnaris and extensor digitorum (all in OpenStax).
